title: The world's strangest borders: enclaves, exclaves, tripoints and a front door in two countries
excerpt: I mapped every enclave, exclave and border oddity in Wikipedia's lists and every tripoint on Natural Earth's map. There are 42 true enclaves in 85 pieces, most too small for the map to see.
seo_description: A map of the world's strangest borders: 42 true enclaves, Baarle, the India and Bangladesh swap, 167 tripoints and Bir Tawil.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The world's strangest borders' with 'strangest' in red, beside a world map dotted with coloured circles for enclaves and other oddities and small black triangles for tripoints. Text: 42 true enclaves in 85 pieces, 167 tripoints, a quadripoint that is not, and an island that changes hands every six months.
